name: 207 Welding & Fabrication
old_description: Explore our custom fabrication options in Hartland, Augusta, Waterville and surrounding areas today.
about:
207 Welding & Fabrication operates from Hartland, Maine, serving the greater Augusta and Waterville areas with mobile welding and fabrication services. The company was founded over a decade ago, though a specific year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been published.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication, mobile welding, and commercial and industrial welding services. Work ranges from small residential repairs to large-scale industrial fabrications, performed on-site via a fully insured mobile unit. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Customers span commercial, industrial, and residential sectors throughout central Maine. The company cites projects for local businesses, farms, and homeowners, but does not name specific industry verticals or clients.

The firm emphasizes local expertise, particularly in handling Maine’s harsh winters, and a commitment to precision and customer satisfaction. Its stated differentiation rests on listening to client needs and delivering beyond expectations with attention to detail.
